about.title: About the data
about.p1: Prices are collected from each shop on the dates shown. Every number on the site comes straight from that data; nothing is estimated or filled in.
about.p2: A shop that is only partly collected, or whose catalogue was imported as a one-off snapshot, is listed above with its status. Where a shop's regular prices can't be verified, its discounts are left out rather than shown wrong.
about.p3: A figure that would rest on too few products is left out, and the page says so in its place.

positioning.line: {shop} is cheaper on {k} of {n} matched products; {equal} cost the same. Median gap {gap}.
positioning.tip: Reviewed exact matches only, at the latest observed price. Gap = ({other} − {base}) ÷ {base}.
positioning.bar: Matched products by which shop is cheaper

size.title: Price gap by size
size.headline: {shop} undercuts most at {size}: median {gap} on {n} matched products.
size.headlineNone: {shop} undercuts on no size with enough matched products.
size.tip: Median gap per size over reviewed exact matches; a bar left of the line means {other} is cheaper than {base}. Sizes with fewer than {min} matches are hidden ({hidden}).
size.row: {n} matches: {other} cheaper at the other shop, {equal} equal, {base} cheaper at the base shop
size.action: Check the sizes where the gap is widest first. Shoppers compare those.

policy.title: Brand price policy
policy.headline: {k, plural, =0 {No brand is} one {# brand is} other {# brands are}} consistently cheaper at {shop}; {p, plural, =0 {none hold} one {# holds} other {# hold}} price parity.
policy.tip: A brand takes a column when at least {share}% of its matched products fall on that side. Brands with fewer than {min} matches are not placed.
policy.row: {n} matches: {other} cheaper at the other shop, {equal} equal, {base} cheaper at the base shop
policy.action: Start brand price talks with the brands in the cheaper-elsewhere column.

space.title: Assortment white space
space.headlineMissing: {present} lists {count} {n, plural, one {product} other {products}} that {absent} does not carry.
space.headlineUnmatched: {present} lists {count} {n, plural, one {product} other {products}} with no reviewed match at {absent}.
space.tip: "No reviewed match" is not proof that {absent} lacks the product: it may be unmatched or not yet crawled. A product counts as missing only after a complete crawl and a reviewed match.
space.action: Review the top brands for listing gaps before treating them as range opportunities.

promo.title: Promotion strategy
promo.headline: {product} at {shop} has the deepest listed cut: −{pct}%.
promo.meta: {n, plural, one {{count} listed discount} other {Top {count} listed discounts}}, deepest first
promo.action: Check the evidence before using a discount in a pricing decision.

stock.title: Brand stock-outs
stock.headline: {brand} at {shop}: {out} observed out-of-stock listings among {observed} observed listings {crawl, select, partial {in a partial crawl} other {in the latest crawl}}.
stock.headlineSome: Brands with at least {min} listings observed out of stock.
stock.tip: Listings observed out of stock at {date}, per brand. These are minimum counts from what was observed, not a share of the brand's range, and shops are not ranked by them. Brands with fewer than {min} out-of-stock listings are hidden ({hidden}).
stock.none: No brand has {min} or more listings observed out of stock.
stock.action: Check supply for the brands at the top: shoppers who cannot buy there may go elsewhere.

traps.title: Size traps
traps.headline: {k} of {n} size steps cost the same or more per unit at the larger size.
traps.meta: Same product, next size up, same shop
traps.tip: Each step compares a product with its next larger size at one shop, per ml or g. Steps that change by more than {held}% are held out as likely data errors ({heldOut}).
traps.perUnit: Change in price per {unit} (sizes grouped by {basis, select, family {the shop's product family} other {product name}})
traps.action: Fix the larger sizes priced above their per-unit value: they read as a trap to shoppers.

more.title: More
more.saving: {shop}: the typical step up in size saves {pct} per unit ({n} steps).
more.method: Price cards count reviewed exact matches only. A brand needs {share}% of its matches on one side to be placed. Size steps beyond {held}% are held out. Any cohort under {min} is hidden.
more.later: Not shown yet, for lack of a backed aggregate: the EDP vs EDT price ladder, price against rating, and verified real discounts.
